message: OK, and which cable do I need for the SAJ H2-10K-T3?

got.text: For the AC grid connection, the manual for the H2 series gives the conductor cross-section for the H2-(10K-30K)-(T2,T3) group as 10 to 16 mm², with 16 mm² recommended; the manual notes that you may choose a larger AC cable diameter for a long grid-connection distance. The same table specifies an additional grounding cable of 8 mm². A circuit breaker must be installed between the grid and the inverter, with 50A recommended for this inverter group, and several inverters must not share one AC circuit breaker. An external RCD is not required because the inverter has an integrated residual current monitoring unit, but where local regulations call for one, type A or B with 300 mA action current can be used. On the DC side, the manual specifies an outdoor multi-core copper cable with a conductor cross-section of 4.0 to 6.0 mm² (4.0 mm² recommended) rated for 1000 VDC.

message: Gut, und welches Kabel brauche ich für den SAJ H2-10K-T3?

got.text: Für den SAJ H2-10K-T3 nennt das Handbuch getrennte Querschnitte für Netz-, Batterie- und PV-Seite. Für das Wechselstromkabel (AC) zum Netz gilt ein Bereich von 10 bis 16 mm², empfohlen sind 16 mm²; das zusätzliche Erdungskabel hat 8 mm². Bei einer langen Netzanschlussstrecke dürfen Sie den AC-Querschnitt verstärken. Für die Batteriekabel sind 8 bis 10 mm² vorgesehen, empfohlen 8 mm². Auf der PV-Seite nennt das Handbuch einen Leiterquerschnitt von 4,0 bis 6,0 mm², empfohlen 4,0 mm² als mehradriges Kupferkabel für den Außenbereich, ausgelegt für 1.000 V DC. Bei langen DC-Leitungen prüfen Sie zusätzlich den Spannungsfall; die Auswahl des Durchmessers für die Netzanschlussstrecke können Sie laut Handbuch verstärken.

message: Can the inverter talk to the team portal?

got.text:
The Trade Portal on this page is described as Linker's channel for wholesale orders and project quotes, and the page does not say that inverters connect to it. Our documents likewise do not state any data link between an inverter and the Linker team portal; a portal connection is not part of what they describe.

What the documents do cover is inverter communication for monitoring and control: GoodWe units reach the SEMS Portal monitoring platform over WiFi, LAN, 4G or GPRS; the H1 series uploads its operating data to a server through a Wi-Fi module on its RS232 interface, with RS485 reserved for the battery management system; and a separate Modbus RTU protocol document covers the communication between GoodWe hybrid inverters and a third-party monitoring device or EMS, including reading live data and remote control. If you tell me which model you are working with, I can check the documents for that unit.

message: Does the GoodWe app have an expert mode?

got.text: Our documents do not describe a section named expert mode in the GoodWe app. What they do describe is an Advanced Settings area in SolarGo: from the Home screen you open Settings and then Advanced Settings, and that area holds the installer-level functions, such as the safety parameter settings, the active power mode settings, the AFCI detection, the power limit parameters and the parameter export. Treat that as the related passage rather than as an expert mode, since the documents do not state an expert mode under that name.

message: Where is the engineer's guide for the SAJ H2?

got.text: The guide you are looking for is our SAJ configuration instructions for H2, HS2 and HS3 systems (English, V1.0). It covers the H2 series together with HS2/AS2 and HS3/AS3, and walks through the required devices, the system connections, the meter address settings and commissioning with the elekeeper app. Its connection chapters are split by grid type: one set for single-phase hybrid inverters, including parallel operation with one EMS over RS485 or LAN and AC-coupling with a solar inverter, and another set for three-phase hybrid inverters, likewise for a single unit, for parallel operation and for AC coupling, plus the CT connection variants. Which chapter applies therefore depends on the model and the grid type. The H2 models shown here are all three-phase, and they differ in their ratings: the H2-10K-T3 at 10 kW, the H2-12K-T3 at 12 kW, the H2-15K-T3 at 15 kW, the H2-20K-T3 at 20 kW, the H2-25K-T3 at 25 kW and the H2-30K-T3-DE at 29.999 kW of rated AC power.

message: Which battery fits the SAJ H2-10K-T3?

got.text: The documented batteries for the SAJ H2-10K-T3 come from the SAJ B2 series. Each of these pairs is released with the matching accessory: the B2 batteries are used as a set of BU2-5.0 modules together with the BC2-HV1 control module, and SAJ's configuration instructions give the H2 series system as H2 + BC2 + BU2. One point to keep in mind is the voltage window: the one-module B2-5.0 is not covered, as its operating voltage lies below the battery voltage range of the H2-10K-T3, and the smallest listed set reaches that range only just. The exact conditions for each pair stand in the pairing documents below.

message: Which battery fits the SAJ H2-10K-T3 with backup?

got.text: For backup operation the documented batteries do not change: the SAJ B2 series remains the pairing partner, and each pair is released with the matching accessory. SAJ's configuration instructions name the required devices of an H2 system as the H2 series storage inverter with a BU2 series battery, together with the BC2 battery control unit, and backup appears there as a working mode of the inverter with its own backup SOC setting rather than as a different battery. The conditions for each pair are given in the pairing documents, and the one-module B2-5.0 stays uncovered because its operating voltage lies below the battery voltage range of the H2-10K-T3.

message: Which battery fits the SAJ H2-8K-T3?

got.text: Our product range does not contain an SAJ H2-8K-T3: the H2-T3 series we list begins with the H2-10K-T3, so for the model you named we have no product entry and therefore no documented battery pairing either. For the H2-T3 series itself the documented partner is the SAJ B2 series, used as BU2 modules together with the BC2-HV1 control module and released with that matching accessory; the conditions and the voltage window stand in the pairing document. If your project needs that power class as a three-phase hybrid inverter from SAJ, our range holds the HS2-8K-T2-X and the HS3-8K-T2-W/G-PX, and I can check the documented battery pairing for either of them on request.
